Hand block printing is one of the three main techniques used for fabric decoration. Skilled artisans carve the required design into hard wood to make the blocks, which are the essential tools for printing. These blocks are dipped sequentially into a dye bath and stamped onto the fabric with skilled precision. A separate block is used for each colour, some fabrics may have as many as 500 block repeats per metre! Wear this unique piece with denims or fitted chudidhars. Reebok Men's Premier Ultra Form Red Shoe. shoes THAT MOULD TO YOUR FEET One run in the reebok Premier Ultra 8 is enough to tell you why you need to own one. Replete with U-form technology and a KineticFit system, running in the reebok Premier Ultra 8 is like running on clouds. Designed as an all-rounder, this lightweight, durable shoe suits runners of all types. So leave your cares behind on whether you are an underpronator or overpronator and go grab for yourself this absolute delight for your feet. Customize them yourself Crafted in a fantastic design, the Reebok Premier Ultra 8 comes with U-form technology that allows you to make the shoe mould to the unique structure of your feet, giving you that premium comfort for maximum performance. To activate the U-form technology, heat the shoe in the oven for three minutes at 200 (degrees) F. Take it out and wear it on for eight minutes, lacing it up nice and tight and you're all set to rule the roost with this perfectly constructed heel. To add to this absolute in comfort is the KineticFit system of the Reebok Premier Ultra 8, which accommodates changes in the size and shape of the runner's feet as an when they move. When you run, the foot can change half a size from impact to toe-off, and it's extremely important that the shoe be able to accommodate such ergonomic changes. The Reebok Premier Ultra 8 fulfills this necessity with utmost ease as it is engineered with stretchable panels that are placed in key areas of the shoe, allowing the shoe to respond naturally to the feet's movement. Slower heel for greater force Added to the comfort, moulding heel Fit is the DMX Shear heel to slow down and distribute stress, cushioning the feet during heelstrike. This allows the feet to move forward in comfort, slowing down the heel and enabling the force to distribute both horizontally and vertically, creating less stress. Engineered with a meshed upper to provide ample breathability, the Reebok Premier Ultra 8 also has synthetic overlays on the upper region of the shoe to add that extra support and stability, locking down the foot in place. The synthetic lace-up system adds on to provide a snug fit, while the removable ortholite footbed ensures your feet are well cushioned at the right places and protected from shock. To ensure ample underfoot cushioning that absorbs shock and enhances energy return propelling you forward with ease, the flexible outsole of the Reebok Premier Ultra 8 is constructed using DMX Ride+ and DMX Ride underfoot foam cushioning. So what are you waiting for? Go ahead and pick your pair now. Nike Men's Lunarelite Black Green Shoe. SHAPED FOR YOUR EVERY STRIDE  Incredibly lightweight with a smooth transition, the nike LunarElite+ model of shoes for men are designed for those who love to run. Without sacrificing on cushioning and shock absorption, the nike LunarElite+ range of shoes is designed in such a manner that it adapts to your stride &ndash  be it long or short.  Great deal for underpronators and overpronators  The Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes are specially engineered for runners with underpronated to moderately overpronated gait. Underpronated and overpronated runners strike the ground at the lateral side of the heel. As the individual transfers weight from the heel to the metatarsus, the foot doesn&rsquo t roll enough in the medial (inside) direction for overpronators and in the lateral (outside) direction for underpronators, which could affect the knee as the foot doesn&rsquo t absorb shock properly. However, the difference lies in the fact that in an underpronator, the ankles do not experience much motion and are rigid, while in an overpronator, the ankles roll inwards making one fall forward easily. Nike realized that it had the responsibility to create the right running shoes that could cater to both underpronators and overpronators, with ample support on both, the lateral and medial sides. This responsibility that it took up resulted in the creation of the Nike LunarElite+ model of shoes.  360 degrees of comfort  Without sacrificing on cushioning, the Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes was created with ultra-light, yet ultra-strong Flywire upper. The Flywire is a lightweight support system that is made of tensile fibres that are joined together to create a foundation to construct the upper material of the shoe. It acts like a super strong synthetic ligament, wrapping around the foot and supporting it precisely where it needs that extra support, mapping the foot morphology like an X-ray. Flywire acts like the second skin giving the runner that ultimate freedom and strength in moving backwards, forwards, sideways, up and down. Think of the direction and Nike LunarElite+ shoes will help you move that way with complete convenience, locking your foot down.  This range of shoes is created with open mesh uppers with strategic overlays for enhanced support at targeted areas of the upper foot to enhance performance, comfort and breathability. The no-sew design employed in key zones ensure proper fitting and enhance comfort.  To add to this snug Fit of the upper is the Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that adds on a plush cushioning to absorb shock protecting the feet, besides adding that extra spring in gait. The dynamic support system adapts to the runner&rsquo s stride, adding that specific support to every phase of the run.  Ultimate in protection  Besides, Nike LunarElite+ shoes are engineered with a dual layer Ortholite insole that is strong and breathable, replete with anti-microbial foam, making this model of shoes ideal for athletes. The cushioned sockliner is made of long lasting material and adds an exceptional step-in feel, while the memory foam at the collar ensures absolute comfort and fit.  The Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes are made of environmentally preferred rubber and employ a modified waffle outsole that makes the shoes durable and multi-surface tractional. ASICS Men GT 2160 Running Blue Sports Shoes. GREET YOUR FEET WITH GREAT RUNS If you are a mild to moderate overpronator looking for a daily running shoe, here's the best bet brought to you by asics. Renowned for its Fit, balanced¬†  and cushioned ride and smooth heel to toe transition, the updated version of the asics GT 2000, the Asics GT 2160 makes you enjoy the best performance everytime. The shoe has an increased memory foam along the heel collar and forefoot, ensuring that the Asics GT 2160 offers plush cushioning and excellent shock absorption. With stability coming as an award-winning heritage factor, the Asics GT 2160 stability running shoe has overcome those few weaknesses found in the 2150 version, making it a pleasure to run in. Reverting to the Asics GT 2140's close fit, the toe box is also narrower compared to the GT 2150, preventing the foot from shifting around in the shoe. Narrow or broad, take your pick This update of the Spring 2011 running collection, the GT 2160 is the lightest running shoe of the GT 2100 series. With the lightweight feature of the GT series still intact, the GT 2160 men's shoe has increased by only 1 oz to 11.5 oz, and the women's shoe stands the same at 9.6 oz. However, unlike its predecessors, the GT 2160 doesn't have an asymmetrical lacing system, but the good old straight lacing system to provide a snug fit, locking the foot in place. The Asics GT 2160 works wonders for those who have a narrow heel as this range of asics shoes comes with narrow sizing options. Highly recommended for overpronators, the Asics GT 2160 running shoe has an improved and more responsive cushioning that greatly contributes towards making it a long term running partner. Torsion stability with midfoot support The GT 2160 is employed with the Duo Max stability system, which is a harder piece of foam injected into the midsole mould, especially around the medial (inside) area of the foot, extending from below the ankle to the mid-heel, making it an ideal shoe for overpronators. This medial support can easily be recognized by its standardised grey colour that prevents the arch from collapsing excessively when running. This running shoe is also employed with the Asics Space Trusstic System stability feature that enhances midfoot support. On the outsole, this midfoot support is represented by a thermal plastic unit or TPU bridge that wraps around the midsole right under the inner arch of the foot, offering torsional stability. This helps prevent the foot from rotating unnaturally. However, the Trusstic System in the GT 2160 is different in men's and women's shoes, with the women's shoe having amore extended bridge that wraps the foot higher enhancing stability, as women has a wider Q-angle. Decoupled heel for plush rides For that extra cushioning, two units of the Asics Gel cushioning system is employed in the heel and forefoot of the Asics GT 2160. The forefoot is made much more plush, while the decoupled heel absorbs shock according to the manner in which the foot lands on the ground, distributing the impact evenly and cushioning the feet from injuries. The main change in the outsole of the Asics 2160 is that it has an Impact Guidance System (IGS). The IGS is a longitudinal groove carved in the midsole. This groove guides the foot through the most efficient stride and also reduces the weight of the shoe, enhancing running speed. Great mileage for great runners Constructed with synthetic overlays, the upper of the GT 2160 wraps tightly around keeping the foot locked down in place. It is employed with a rich and removable sockliner that allows the runner to fit an orthotic into the shoe for added ergonomic comfort. The ComforDry sockliner of the Asics GT 2160 provides extra amortization and anti-microbial technology that reduces bad odour and keeps the feet fresh and dry. The heel collar of the GT 2160 includes memory foam on the inside and outside, making it all the more plush and comfortable. One of the best running shoes ever created this season, the GT 2160 is a great wear for mild to moderate overpronators. Offering plenty of support and great mileage, the Asics GT 2160 is a great buy for serious runners. Asics Women GT 2160 Performance Silver Pink Shoe. GREET YOUR FEET WITH GREAT RUNS  If you are a mild to moderate overpronator looking for a daily running shoe, here's the best bet brought to you by asics. Renowned for its Fit, balanced¬†  and cushioned ride and smooth heel to toe transition, the updated version of the asics GT 2000, the Asics GT 2160 makes you enjoy the best performance everytime. The shoe has an increased memory foam along the heel collar and forefoot, ensuring that the Asics GT 2160 offers plush cushioning and excellent shock absorption.  With stability coming as an award-winning heritage factor, the Asics GT 2160 stability running shoe has overcome those few weaknesses found in the 2150 version, making it a pleasure to run in. Reverting to the Asics GT 2140's close fit, the toe box is also narrower compared to the GT 2150, preventing the foot from shifting around in the shoe.  Narrow or broad, take your pick  This update of the Spring 2011 running collection, the GT 2160 is the lightest running shoe of the GT 2100 series. With the lightweight feature of the GT series still intact, the GT 2160 men's shoe has increased by only 1 oz to 11.5 oz, and the women's shoe stands the same at 9.6 oz. However, unlike its predecessors, the GT 2160 doesn't have an asymmetrical lacing system, but the good old straight lacing system to provide a snug fit, locking the foot in place.  The Asics GT 2160 works wonders for those who have a narrow heel as this range of asics shoes comes with narrow sizing options. Highly recommended for overpronators, the Asics GT 2160 running shoe has an improved and more responsive cushioning that greatly contributes towards making it a long term running partner.  Torsion stability with midfoot support  The GT 2160 is employed with the Duo Max stability system, which is a harder piece of foam injected into the midsole mould, especially around the medial (inside) area of the foot, extending from below the ankle to the mid-heel, making it an ideal shoe for overpronators. This medial support can easily be recognized by its standardised grey colour that prevents the arch from collapsing excessively when running. This running shoe is also employed with the Asics Space Trusstic System stability feature that enhances midfoot support.  On the outsole, this midfoot support is represented by a thermal plastic unit or TPU bridge that wraps around the midsole right under the inner arch of the foot, offering torsional stability. This helps prevent the foot from rotating unnaturally. However, the Trusstic System in the GT 2160 is different in men's and women's shoes, with the women's shoe having amore extended bridge that wraps the foot higher enhancing stability, as women has a wider Q-angle.  Decoupled heel for plush rides  For that extra cushioning, two units of the Asics Gel cushioning system is employed in the heel and forefoot of the Asics GT 2160. The forefoot is made much more plush, while the decoupled heel absorbs shock according to the manner in which the foot lands on the ground, distributing the impact evenly and cushioning the feet from injuries. The main change in the outsole of the Asics 2160 is that it has an Impact Guidance System (IGS). The IGS is a longitudinal groove carved in the midsole. This groove guides the foot through the most efficient stride and also reduces the weight of the shoe, enhancing running speed.  Great mileage for great runners  Constructed with synthetic overlays, the upper of the GT 2160 wraps tightly around keeping the foot locked down in place. It is employed with a rich and removable sockliner that allows the runner to fit an orthotic into the shoe for added ergonomic comfort. The ComforDry sockliner of the Asics GT 2160 provides extra amortization and anti-microbial technology that reduces bad odour and keeps the feet fresh and dry. The heel collar of the GT 2160 includes memory foam on the inside and outside, making it all the more plush and comfortable.  One of the best running shoes ever created this season, the GT 2160 is a great wear for mild to moderate overpronators. Offering plenty of support and great mileage, the Asics GT 2160 is a great buy for serious runners. FIRM Fit FOR SMOOTH RIDES The asics Gel Pulse 3 doesn't feature is a lot of fancy padding and exotic material like its predecessor the Gel Nimbus 12. But what it does have is absolute balance. With a¬† cushioning that is firm enough to protect the legs during long runs, but equally soft for a comfortable ride, the just about 12 oz heavy asics Gel Pulse 3 is a highly recommended everyday trainer for runners with normal to high arches. With a not so ideal mushy cushioning, the forefoot of the Asics Gel Pulse 3 is designed to feel a little stiffer compared to other running shoes . This is a deliberate feature to speed up the forefoot's transition from mid-distance to toe-off. Firm and responsive run To add to this excellent transition are the flex grooves in the outsole that make for superb heel to toe transition, what with the Asics Gel Pulse 2 not having a very wide toe box. Engineered with this improved forefoot feel, the Asics Gel Pulse 2 is tuned towards a firm and responsive run. Pulsing with protection and comfort Constructed with a lightweight, breathable mesh upper, the Asics Gel Pulse 3 running shoe ensures it offers ample ventilation to the feet, keeping them dry, fresh and free of sweat. Engineered with a rearfoot Gel cushioning system, the heel is well locked in place and is protected from impact, allowing for a smooth mid-distance transition. The insole is also built with a Comforter Sockliner that not only provides ample cushioning, enhancing performance, but also employs anti-microbial properties, creating a cooler, drier and healthier environment inside the shoe. The SpEVA midsole material improves the bounce back characteristics of the Asics Gel Pulse 3 running shoe, decreasing midsole breakdown, while the Trusstic System employed in the outsole enhances traction. This plastic shank connecting the forefoot and heel of the outsole doesn't touch the ground. It instead curves around the medial side of the foot, arching neatly and locking the foot in place. EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS  An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet.  The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It&rsquo s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe.  Breezy touch to snug shoes  With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot.  Adapts to the runner's needs  Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner&rsquo s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer&rsquo s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability.  No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe.  Stay safe in the dark  The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe.  Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible guaging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes.  Wash care 1. Brush surface with damp, clean cloth to remove dust 2. Do not machine wash

Asics Men's Gel Phoenix 3 Running White Black Shoe. BACK TO THE FUTURE  Stretch  yourself, push your limits further away and overcome those long tough  runs in the asics Gel Phoenix 3 running shoes . Designed for the runner  who knows how to conquer the toughest of the tough, this super strong  running shoe from asics is replete with enhanced stability and  cushioning, and is specially recommended for those with a mild  overpronated gait.  The  Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of lightweight material, helping its  creators keep its weight at just about 9 oz. Constructed using synthetic  material, the upper of this shoe is meshed enhancing breathability,  keeping the feet dry and fresh even after a long run. Added to this  meshed upper are synthetic overlays that add structure and durable  support to the shoe. The upper is also fitted with reflective elements  that make it a safe wear even in low light conditions.  The  inside of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is employed with a padded tongue and  sockliner that not only provides a soft and cushioned feel, but also  locks the rearfoot in place, ensuring a snug Fit and protection from  shock. The contoured sockliner in the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 offers a  lightweight plush feel, and is removable allowing runners to place an  orthotic for better comfort.  Return of energy   The  midsole of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of highly resilient SpEVA  that offers excellent energy return allowing greater and more  comfortable propulsion. Created of DuoMax dual density, the midsole is  positioned in a¬† specific manner to enhance stability and support when  running. The midsole comfort and stability is further enhanced using a  California Slip Lasting, while the upper is stitched around the EVA  board and directly attached to the midsole to offer a seamless fit and  abrasion-free comfort. The rearfoot is employed with a Rearfoot Gel  cushioning system that attenuates shock, allowing for a smooth  transition to mid-distance.  Durability at its best   Created  using Asics High Abrasion Rubber (AHAR), the outsole of the Asics Gel  Phoenix 3 is known for its supreme durability. This AHAR technology is  placed strategically in those parts of the outsole that is especially  prone to wear and tear, enhancing shoe life. The forefoot is made of  flex grooves for easy movement, while the forefoot and heel of the  outsole connected with the Asics Trusstic System, which is a plastic  shank wrapping neatly around the medial side of the foot, reducing the  overall weight of the sole unit and retaining the structural integrity  of the shoe. Firm and responsive run   To  add to this excellent transition are the flex grooves in the outsole  that make for superb heel to toe transition, what with the Asics Gel  Pulse 2 not having a very wide toe box. Pulsing with protection and comfort   Constructed  with a lightweight, breathable mesh upper, the Asics Gel Pulse 2  running shoe ensures it offers ample ventilation to the feet, keeping  them dry, fresh and free of sweat. Engineered with a rearfoot Gel  cushioning system, the heel is well locked in place and is protected  from impact, allowing for a smooth mid-distance transition. The  SpEVA midsole material improves the bounce back characteristics of the  Asics Gel Pulse 2 running shoe, decreasing midsole breakdown, while the  Trusstic System employed in the outsole enhances traction. This plastic  shank connecting the forefoot and heel of the outsole doesn't touch the  ground. It instead curves around the medial side of the foot, arching  neatly and locking the foot in place. EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS  An  absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless  comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support.  Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a  springy effect for the feet.  The Nike  Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer  feel to the underfoot. It&rsquo s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators  and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the  medial and lateral side of the shoe.  Breezy touch to snug shoes  With a  stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet  and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed  using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample  ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during  long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and  move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and  out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely  snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot.  Adapts to the runner's needs  Light in  weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are  employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up  of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam  carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy  response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the  runner&rsquo s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer&rsquo s stride through each  run giving the right amount of support and stability.  No wonder  overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in  the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight  or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral  pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such  runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting  this same shoe into a neutral running shoe.  Stay safe in the dark  The  outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and  breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an  outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern  outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. This earthy shirt by fabindia for men is perfect for the artsy intellectual. The superior comfort afforded by the pure cotton fabric and traditional yet fashionable hand block print makes this a wardrobe essential. Hand block printing is one of the three main techniques used for fabric decoration. Skilled artisans carve the required design into hard wood to make the blocks, which are the essential tools for printing. These blocks are dipped sequentially into a dye bath and stamped onto the fabric with skilled precision. A separate block is used for each colour, some fabrics may have as many as 500 block repeats per metre! Pair this unique piece with colourful cotton trousers to go all out and make a colour block statement. For the more conservative, pair it with simple form fitting denims and sandals. Asics Men's Gel Nimbus 12 Grey Orange Shoe. THE KING OF CUSHIONED shoes  Designed with a great amount of soft and plush cushioning, the asics Gel Nimbus 12 has become a referral model for other shoes engineered with cushioning technology. Offering absolute stability, these running shoes are highly recommended for neutral runners and moderate overpronators who begin to feel the stress of their gait otherwise during long runs.  Gender specific engineering  The asics Gel Nimbus 12 is engineered with Gel technology in its midsole, with goblets of silicon based gel inserted in the forefoot and heel to enhance shock absorption and protect the feet from impact. The midsole is cushioned with a Solyte foam for lightweight comfort.  But what makes the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 stand apart is that it merges its cushioning elements with its support features, ensuring that the runner's gait is kept correct and steady. The base of the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 is wide, providing ample stability, while the heel is decoupled to provide that right amount of shock absorption in the right places. In the women's version of this shoe, the heel is 3mm higher than the men's range, relieving stress from the Achilles tendon.  Bridge of comfort and stability  The most important characteristic of the Nimbus is its Space Trusstic System. This is a transition bridge that embraces the midsole under the arch of the foot, providing torsion stability during heelstrike and toe-off. This plastic shank in the outsole ensures that the foot doesn't twist unnaturally, keeping it safe from injuries.  This transition bridge made of a solid plastic compound is only employed on the medial or inner side of the underfoot to give the shoe the ultimate in stability. This shank is also specifically engineered for men and women, making it a nearly customised running shoe ever created.  The outsole is also employed with the Asics special Impact Guidance System - a vertical flex groove that extends from the toe to the heel ensuring a proper gait during every stride.  Busy shoe for busy runners  The upper of the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 is richly featured, giving it a busy look. With a well executed collar and heel liner filled with memory foam, the heel is locked comfortably in the shoe, keeping it safe from impact and injuries. The upper is also employed with an asymmetrical lacing system, where the laces are in a curved line along the natural shape of the foot. This locks the foot perfectly in place providing a more snug and comfort Fit.  What's also special about this shoe is that it has individual and independent eyelets that are connected with several overlays to the midsole, giving the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 a classy look.  Wash care Wipe surface with soft, clean, cloth or brush, cold water and mild detergent to remove dust Do not machine wash or use a drier Avoid storing shoes in extremely hot conditions or in sunlight

Asics Men's Gel Phoenix 3 Black Silver Shoe. BACK TO THE FUTURE  Stretch yourself, push your limits further away and overcome those long tough runs in the asics Gel Phoenix 3 running shoes . Designed for the runner who knows how to conquer the toughest of the tough, this super strong running shoe from asics is replete with enhanced stability and cushioning, and is specially recommended for those with a mild overpronated gait.  The Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of lightweight material, helping its creators keep its weight at just about 9 oz. Constructed using synthetic material, the upper of this shoe is meshed enhancing breathability, keeping the feet dry and fresh even after a long run. Added to this meshed upper are synthetic overlays that add structure and durable support to the shoe. The upper is also fitted with reflective elements that make it a safe wear even in low light conditions.  The inside of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is employed with a padded tongue and sockliner that not only provides a soft and cushioned feel, but also locks the rearfoot in place, ensuring a snug Fit and protection from shock. The contoured sockliner in the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 offers a lightweight plush feel, and is removable allowing runners to place an orthotic for better comfort.  Return of energy  The midsole of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of highly resilient SpEVA that offers excellent energy return allowing greater and more comfortable propulsion. Created of DuoMax dual density, the midsole is positioned in a¬† specific manner to enhance stability and support when running. The midsole comfort and stability is further enhanced using a California Slip Lasting, while the upper is stitched around the EVA board and directly attached to the midsole to offer a seamless fit and abrasion-free comfort. The rearfoot is employed with a Rearfoot Gel cushioning system that attenuates shock, allowing for a smooth transition to mid-distance.  Durability at its best  Created using Asics High Abrasion Rubber (AHAR), the outsole of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is known for its supreme durability. This AHAR technology is placed strategically in those parts of the outsole that is especially prone to wear and tear, enhancing shoe life. The forefoot is made of flex grooves for easy movement, while the forefoot and heel of the outsole connected with the Asics Trusstic System, which is a plastic shank wrapping neatly around the medial side of the foot, reducing the overall weight of the sole unit and retaining the structural integrity of the shoe. RIGID BUILD FOR CLASSIC RUNS Though for a cushioning shoe it's quite chunky, the adidas Supernova Glide 3 gives runners that absolutely cushy heel and secure upper feel making it a widely loved running and training shoe for those with a neutral gait. Even mild overpronators find great comfort and stability in the adidas Supernova Glide 3 as it has a plushed out midsole that provides enough support. Such a construction of this shoe that weighs about 349 grams, makes it a highly recommended one for runners with mid to high arches and for those who are looking for the mild extra support. Specially designed for the runner demanding excessive cushioning and stability, the Adidas Supernova Glide 3 is an innovative creation of an all-round shoe. A neutral trainer packed with a cushioning punch, this shoe features the AdiPRENE technology in its heel and forefoot region, providing ample cushioning both, during heelstrike and toe-off. Its rigid build encourages heel to toe transition, making it a great hit among runners with high arches. As a bonanza, the thee stripe midfoot overlay wrap and beefy midsole on the inside of the shoe add that extra support for mild overpronators. Safe heels While there are several neutral trainers available in the market, what sets the Adidas Supernova Glide 3 apart is that it doesn't compromise on technological features and details. Incorporating every bit of comfort that a shoe can offer you, the Adidas Supernova Glide 3 has an anti-microbial sockliner that ensures your feet are well protected from sweat and infections even during heavy workouts and long runs. Engineered with Geofit technology in the heel and collar regions for enhanced comfort and protection from impact, the Adidas Supernova Glide 3 has a soft, non-piling lining. The heel collar cup wraps around the heel for a snug and secure Fit, providing a great starting point for every stride. Such snug fit and comfort lining adapt to every stride of your foot, creating a customized feel. Splay your toes The meshed upper provides ample ventilation for the feet, while the three strips of reinforced synthetic leather overlays enhance midfoot support, besides representing Adidas' belief of perseverance and strength. The toe box provides ample room for your toes to spread apart comfortably when running, preventing them from brushing against the inner walls of the shoe and getting blistered. The Adidas Supernova Glide 3 also features microsuede inserts on the upper that are seamlessly stitched, providing additional structure. The lace-up system comes as an advantage adding to the snug, comfort fit and locking the foot in place. The outsole is features a FORMOTION heel unit ensuring cushioning at its best and offering absolute comfort and tractional stability for a controlled running experience even during long runs. Created of durable rubber with AdiWEAR technology, the outsole is sure to stay your friend for years on and, even with regular use. So jet set, get yourself an Adidas Supernova Glide 3 and sync your training goals with the absolute in cushioning, stability and style. Pair this with miCoach compatibles and track your performance, while you enjoy those long, healthy runs in these comfy, durable trainers. The outcome: a progressive sneaker that forces tougher functioning of important muscle tissues, toning up the leg and butt. Asics Women Sport Gel Pulse 2 Blue White Shoe. FIRM Fit FOR SMOOTH RIDES  The  asics Gel Pulse 2 doesn't feature is a lot of fancy padding and exotic  material like its predecessor the Gel Nimbus 12. But what it does have  is absolute balance. With a¬†  cushioning that is firm enough to protect  the legs during long runs, but equally soft for a comfortable ride, the  just about 12 oz heavy asics Gel Pulse 2 is a highly recommended  everyday trainer for runners with normal to high arches.  With  a not so ideal mushy cushioning, the forefoot of the Asics Gel Pulse 2  is designed to feel a little stiffer compared to other running shoes .  This is a deliberate feature to speed up the forefoot's transition from  mid-distance to toe-off. The SpEVA midsole of this shoe seems just  perfect and offsets the Asics Gel Pulse 2's lack of a Gel cushioned  forefoot.  Firm and responsive run   To  add to this excellent transition are the flex grooves in the outsole  that make for superb heel to toe transition, what with the Asics Gel  Pulse 2 not having a very wide toe box. Engineered with this improved  forefoot feel, the Asics Gel Pulse 2 is tuned towards a firm and  responsive run.  Pulsing with protection and comfort   Constructed  with a lightweight, breathable mesh upper, the Asics Gel Pulse 2  running shoe ensures it offers ample ventilation to the feet, keeping  them dry, fresh and free of sweat. Engineered with a rearfoot Gel  cushioning system, the heel is well locked in place and is protected  from impact, allowing for a smooth mid-distance transition. The insole  is also built with a Comforter Sockliner that not only provides ample  cushioning, enhancing performance, but also employs anti-microbial  properties, creating a cooler, drier and healthier environment inside  the shoe.  The  SpEVA midsole material improves the bounce back characteristics of the  Asics Gel Pulse 2 running shoe, decreasing midsole breakdown, while the  Trusstic System employed in the outsole enhances traction. This plastic  shank connecting the forefoot and heel of the outsole doesn't touch the  ground. It instead curves around the medial side of the foot, arching  neatly and locking the foot in place.
